verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a dedicated 'Chat with Qodo' feature for interacting with it directly inside pull requests [qodo-docs-23]. Users can discuss or dismiss a finding, or have Qodo apply the fix [qodo-docs-3], and can remediate issues through a 'Fix with Chat Agent' flow while chatting [qodo-docs-51]. This covers the core of in-thread conversation and action requests. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a command syntax (e.g., slash commands) for issuing instructions, detail on how replies use thread and finding context, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat quality.
